verdict.rationale: Jeeves' corporate card page advertises "1% cashback on every purchase," so the card-spend cashback core of the story is there, and "every purchase" suggests it accrues automatically. That is a single marketing line, though, and nothing describes how cashback is credited or whether it needs manual redemption. Missing for 10: documentation that cashback is applied automatically without redemption steps, details on how and when cashback posts (statement credit or account deposit), eligibility terms or caps, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
